title: 'Tattoo (Remix)' Video Hits One Billion Views
summary:
The music video for "Tattoo (Remix)" by Rauw Alejandro and Camilo has now been watched more than one billion times on YouTube. That puts it in YouTube's Billion Views Club, Billboard reports.

Alejandro is a singer from Puerto Rico. He first released "Tattoo" in February 2020. In July 2020, he shared a new version with Camilo, a singer from Colombia. It was the first song the two made together.

The song is reggaeton, a kind of music with Latin and Caribbean roots. In the video, the singers have a fun day with friends on Miami Beach.

Fans loved it. A TikTok dance challenge called #TattooChallenge helped the song reach number one on two Billboard Latin radio charts.

Alejandro has had 13 songs on the Billboard Hot 100. Last month, he played shows at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, New York.
why_it_matters: It shows how a fun song and an online dance challenge can make a video popular with people all over the world.

keywords.explanation: A remix is a new version of a song.
Reggaeton is a kind of dance music with Latin and Caribbean roots.
An online challenge is a trend where many people copy the same dance or activity.
Music charts are lists that rank the most popular songs.
A billion is one thousand million, a very big number.

background_read: YouTube's Billion Views Club is for music videos watched more than one billion times.
Online dance challenges can help songs reach many new fans.

WHAT: Their 'Tattoo (Remix)' music video passed one billion views
